setup.comfy.title: ComfyUI workflow editor
setup.reuseHelp: Open the checked DEAS installation without reinstalling, updating or deleting files. Backend start remains a separate action.
setup.autoHelp: Checked automatically. Change the folder or add Director if you like, then start.
setup.autoBrowser: Browser preview cannot detect hardware or the executable directory. Enter a new absolute directory and select a backend manually.
setup.autoFindings: Recommended defaults. No files have been written.
setup.cpuRecommendation: CPU recommended: no supported NVIDIA stack was verified. CPU execution is slower; you can edit the backend.
setup.autoConsent: Start install authorizes only the reviewed native plan, including its downloads and filesystem changes.
setup.aio.label: AiO installer
setup.aio.description: Native Rust setup — no installation has run.
setup.capabilityHelp: ComfyUI is the core. Director is optional and includes Forge, RefMods, Continuity and Output as one package.
setup.backendHelp: For example http://127.0.0.1:8188. Existing services remain untouched.
setup.optionsHelp: Unsupported choices block native execution instead of silently falling back. Hardware detection does not verify these optional packages.
setup.blocked: This native plan cannot execute. Change unsupported choices and prepare a new plan.
setup.installedNotReady: Provisioning and its required runtime checks succeeded. Studio capabilities, models and generation readiness remain unverified.
setup.error.backend: Enter an HTTP/S URL without credentials, spaces, query or fragment.
setup.step.route.label: Choose your setup
setup.step.storage.label: Choose storage
setup.step.storage.description: Enter an absolute directory for the app-owned environment. No disk or permission check has run.
setup.step.pack.label: Choose optional capabilities
setup.step.pack.description: ComfyUI core needs no extra capability. Select Director to include Forge, RefMods, Continuity and Output together, then confirm.
setup.step.acceleration.label: Choose backend
setup.step.acceleration.description: Select CPU or a GPU vendor, review optional packages and Git ref, then confirm. Detected hardware only prefills; it never confirms or advances.
setup.step.backend.label: Existing backend address
setup.step.backend.description: HTTP/S only. No connection happens while planning.
setup.step.review.label: Review local plan
setup.step.review.description: Review your exact choices before requesting a native plan. No installation has run.
setup.route.managed.label: New app-owned install
setup.route.managed.description: Plan a separate managed environment. Nothing is installed yet.
setup.route.existing.label: Connect existing backend
setup.route.existing.description: Read-only inspection only after your explicit approval.
setup.feature.director.label: Director
setup.feature.director.description: Optional Director bundle with Forge, RefMods, Continuity and Output. Models and studio generation remain unimplemented.
setup.feature.forge.label: Prompt Forge
setup.feature.forge.description: Prompt assistance included in Director, not a separate setup extra.
setup.feature.refmods.label: RefMods
setup.feature.refmods.description: Reference guidance included in Director; studio integration remains planned.
setup.feature.continuity.label: Continuity
setup.feature.continuity.description: Continuity guidance included in Director; studio integration remains planned.
setup.backend.cpu.label: CPU — explicit baseline
setup.backend.cpu.description: Use the CPU backend without assuming a GPU.
setup.backend.nvidia.label: NVIDIA / CUDA
setup.backend.nvidia.description: Request NVIDIA support; native compatibility gates apply.
setup.backend.amd.label: AMD / ROCm
setup.backend.amd.description: Request AMD support; native compatibility gates apply.
setup.backend.intel.label: Intel / XPU
setup.backend.intel.description: Request Intel support; native compatibility gates apply.
installer.steps.ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg binary in the managed environment
setup.error.child: Enter a safe single new folder name, without separators, traversal or reserved names.
setup.feature.output.label: Output
setup.feature.output.description: Included visual output capability, not an independent native install feature.
setup.backendLifecycle.title: Owned backend
setup.backendLifecycle.help: DEAS starts only its checked environment. Automatic startup is on by default and can be disabled in Settings. Native status checks only this app’s owned backend; foreign services are never adopted or stopped. Inspection is read-only.
setup.backendLifecycle.browser: Backend lifecycle is available only in the desktop app. Browser preview cannot start, stop or inspect native lifecycle status.
setup.backendLifecycle.notReady: Generation readiness is not verified. DEAS owns all inputs, controls and outputs; ComfyUI is execution-only.
settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Folders used by the owned backend. Empty = default inside the environment. Saved beside the environment; applied at the next backend start.
settings.noRoot: Settings belong to an environment; set the storage directory first.
settings.draftHelp: Optional existing folders. Empty uses the environment defaults. These choices are part of Start install; selecting folders writes nothing.
settings.move: Move existing files to the selected folders
settings.moveHelp: Close other apps using these folders. Stop the owned backend and finish downloads first. Any filename collision aborts before copying. Files are verified before originals are removed; paths are saved only after successful copying.
setup.remembered: Installed in {path}. The environment is checked before reuse; backend autostart can be disabled in Settings.
settings.language.custom: The system language is {name}; choose the first entry to follow it again.
setup.backendLifecycle.testHelp: Runs a quick read-only dependency check (environment, venv, ComfyUI, DaSiWa nodes, backend API) and refreshes status. Starts nothing.
setup.backendLifecycle.inspectHelp: Connects the editor to the running owned backend at its current endpoint.
setup.reinstallWarning: This overwrites the installation: the backend is stopped, the Python environment (venv) is deleted and rebuilt, and ComfyUI and the DaSiWa nodes are reset to their latest version (local code changes are lost). Models, inputs, outputs, workflows and settings are kept.
startup.title: Startup optimizations
startup.help: ComfyUI launch options for the DEAS backend. Apply saves them and restarts the backend; it never restarts during a running job.
startup.fast.fp16_accumulation: fp16 accumulation: faster fp16 matrix math, slightly lower precision
startup.fast.fp8_matrix_mult: fp8 matrix math for fp8 models; can change quality
startup.fast.autotune: Autotune kernels: first run per size is slower, may use more VRAM
startup.fastHelp: Marked by ComfyUI as experimental; only the checked features are passed, never all of them.
startup.applied: Saved. A running backend restarts with the new options; a stopped one uses them on its next start.
startup.jobRunning: Saved. A job is running, so the backend was not restarted; use Restart once it has finished.
startup.preset.speed.help: Default. Comfy Kitchen INT8 attention, fp16 accumulation and kernel autotune where the GPU supports them (Comfy Kitchen: NVIDIA RTX 20 series / SM 7.5 or newer). Small numerical differences, not bit-identical.
startup.preset.compatibility.help: Only kernel autotune: identical math on every NVIDIA GPU; the first run at each new size is slower.
startup.preset.off.help: ComfyUI's own defaults, no extra launch options.
startup.highvramHelp: Turns off ComfyUI's Dynamic VRAM and keeps every model in VRAM: faster model switching only when everything fits; large video models can run out of memory.
startup.vaeHelp: Default: ComfyUI chooses per VAE type and GPU (usually bf16 on RTX 30 and newer). The options force one setting for every VAE.
setup.takeover.label: Adopt a foreign installation (rebuild its venv)
setup.takeover.warning: DEAS deletes and rebuilds this folder’s venv and runtime, resets the chosen ComfyUI ref and takes over management. Models, inputs, outputs and untracked files are kept.
setup.takeover.help: Only local folders containing ComfyUI/main.py that DEAS does not already manage. Connect running servers via the backend address instead.
setup.takeover.pickTitle: Choose a ComfyUI installation to adopt
setup.takeover.title: Adopt this installation?
setup.takeover.managedError: This folder is already managed by DEAS — reopen it from the saved environment instead.
setup.updateWarning: Download and replace DEAS with the latest binary if available, then stop and upgrade the owned backend, ComfyUI, DaSiWa nodes and Python packages (Torch stays pinned)? Models and media are kept. DEAS will close and reopen automatically after a binary update.
setup.updateAppWarning: Download and replace DEAS with the latest binary if available? DEAS will close and reopen automatically afterwards.
setup.updateRestart: DEAS binary updated. Restarting automatically when updates and project saves are complete…
